title: 第三章 厉害的表姑第四章 武道树的初作用
lines: 回后院路上，丫鬟小翠忍不住道：“夫人，这事情您直接跟周护院说一声不就可以了吗？”
李敏轻笑一声：“凡是我家中亲戚之事，从来都是由着老爷做主。刘氏今日送了什么过来？”
“有周氏腊味坊两只板鸭，还有一匹……”
“让后厨中午把板鸭装盘送来。”李敏打断了小翠后续要报的礼物名单。
接近午时。
蔡老爷回了府，先是去了大夫人处，盏茶时间后便是到了李敏院落。
李敏伺候着蔡老爷脱衣净手，下人很快送上精致菜肴。
“敏儿今日怎么想着吃板鸭了？”蔡老爷看着桌上的板鸭，有些好奇问道。
“老爷还记得我有一位姨妈的儿媳妇吗，就是她今日送来的，我当时就让后厨拿了去处理了。”
李敏说完，面色突然冷了下来，蔡老爷看着李敏神情变化，心里倒是有些好奇了，以往在敏儿口中，那刘氏是个有分寸的人，敏儿即便说不上多亲近，可也不至于是冷着脸的态度。
“听你提过几次，有些印象，你姨妈家……那个刘氏？可是有什么事情？”
听到自家老爷这话，李敏心里也是轻叹一声，自家亲戚不少，可能够让老爷记住的没几位，刘氏从未见过老爷，老爷能够记住，就是因为刘氏每年都上门走动。
不然临时抱佛脚，即便自己愿意帮忙，也开不了这口。
“一点小事，老爷不用在意。”李敏漫不经心，随后给蔡老爷倒了杯酒。
“说给老爷听听。”蔡老爷抿了一口酒，笑呵呵问道。
李敏有些无奈地放下酒壶，埋怨道：“刘氏每年都有来走动，留下礼物就走，我看她本分，加上这礼物也不值几个钱，便就由着她了，没想到刘氏心大的很，今天带着侄儿上门，竟想要让府中护院教导习武。”
蔡老爷捏着酒杯顿了一下：“我记得你说过，你姨妈家里男人都离世了，家里还有钱学武？”
“说是家里没有男人，想让我那侄儿跟着护院学点拳脚功夫，不至于被人欺负。”李敏不屑轻哼一声：“真以为我傻啊，要只是学点拳脚功夫，去哪不能学，分明就是想学真正的武学，还舍不得花钱，把主意打到咱们家头上来了，留他们吃顿饭，我已经是尽到了亲戚情谊了，等吃完就让小翠打发他们离去。”
蔡老爷刚刚只是随口一问，可听到李敏这话，却是有了心思：“敏儿，会不会是你多想了？”
“老爷你也把我当傻子吗？”李敏嗔怪，纤纤玉手戳了下蔡老爷下巴胡须：“我那侄儿今年十八了，真怕别人欺负孤儿寡母的，不如给取个媳妇，找那些家里兄弟多的姑娘，不比他学点拳脚功夫有震慑力？”
“敏儿果然聪明。”蔡老爷抚须大笑：“不过孤儿寡母也不容易，反正不是什么大事，能帮就帮一把，你让他们去找周护院，就说是老爷我吩咐的。”
“老爷！”李敏嘟着嘴，一脸不情愿：“您今天帮了这事，被我家里其他亲戚知道，日后不知道有多少求上门的，我不得被烦死，不行。”
“此事就这么说了，你要不想出面，就让你那丫鬟带他们去找周护卫。”
蔡老爷一锤定音，伸手按住李敏的肩膀往怀里搂，李敏有些生气甩肩，但到底还是没有躲开，最后不情愿地坐在蔡老爷怀里。
“别生气了，下次老爷我去府城，给你带点好东西回来。”
“这还差不多。”
被蔡老爷搂住宽慰的李敏，背着蔡老爷低头的一瞬间，眉眼有着一抹得意。
午后。
“林夫人，夫人那边有些事情，不能亲自过来，关于小郎君要习武之事，特意交代让我带小郎君去找周护院。”
丫鬟小翠前来，因蔡府后院是专供护院和男家丁居住之所，刘氏不适合前去。
“麻烦翠儿姑娘了，砚儿你去吧。”
刘氏递给了林砚一个钱袋子：“见到周护院，要懂礼数。”
content_en:
On the way back to the backyard, the maid Xiaocui couldn't help but said: "Madam, can't you just tell Zhou Huyuan about this matter?"
Li Min chuckled lightly: "Everything about my relatives in my family has always been decided by my master. What did Mr. Liu send here today?"
"There are two salted ducks from Zhou's Cured Meat Shop, and one..."
"Ask the chef to bring the salted duck to a plate at noon." Li Min interrupted Xiao Cui's subsequent list of gifts.
It's close to noon.
Mr. Cai returned to his house, first went to the eldest lady's house, and then went to Li Min's courtyard after tea time.
Li Min waited on Mr. Cai to take off his clothes and clean his hands, and the servants quickly served exquisite dishes.
"Why did Min'er want to eat salted duck today?" Mr. Cai looked at the salted duck on the table and asked curiously.
"Master, do you still remember that I have an aunt's daughter-in-law? She sent it today. I asked the kitchen to take it and deal with it."
After Li Min finished speaking, his expression suddenly turned cold. Mr. Cai became a little curious when he saw the change in Li Min's expression. In the past, Min'er said that Ms. Liu was a measured person. Even though Min'er couldn't be said to be very close, she didn't have a cold-faced attitude.
"I heard you mention it a few times, and I have some impression that your aunt's family...that Liu family? But what's going on?"
Hearing her master's words, Li Min sighed in her heart. She had many relatives, but few of them could be remembered by her master. Mrs. Liu had never met her master. The master could remember her because Mrs. Liu visited her every year.
Otherwise, you will be improvising, and even if you are willing to help, you will not be able to open this mouth.
"Don't worry about this little thing, sir." Li Min said nonchalantly, then poured a glass of wine for Mr. Cai.
"Tell me to the master." Mr. Cai took a sip of wine and asked with a smile.
Li Min put down the wine bottle helplessly and complained: "Ms. Liu comes here every year, leaving gifts and then leaving. I see her duty, and the gift is not worth much, so I let her do it. I didn't expect that Mrs. Liu is very big-hearted. Today she brought her nephew to the door, and she actually wanted to teach martial arts to the Fuzhong Nursing School."
Mr. Cai paused while holding the wine glass: "I remember you said that all the men in your aunt's family have passed away, but the family still has money to learn martial arts?"
"It's because there is no man in the family, and I want my nephew to learn some boxing and kicking from the nursing school so that he won't be bullied." Li Min snorted with disdain: "I really think I'm stupid. If I just want to learn some boxing and kicking, I can't learn it anywhere. It's obvious that I want to learn real martial arts, and I'm not willing to spend money. I've set my sights on our family. By letting them have a meal, I've done my best to show my friendship as a relative. I'll let Xiaocui send them away after they finish."
Mr. Cai just asked casually, but after hearing Li Min's words, he had an idea: "Min'er, are you overthinking it?"
"Master, do you think I'm a fool too?" Li Min scolded, and poked Master Cai's chin beard with her slender hand: "My nephew is eighteen this year. I'm really afraid that others will bully orphans and widowed mothers. Why don't you find a daughter-in-law who has many brothers in the family? Wouldn't he be more intimidating than him by learning some boxing and kicking skills?"
"Min'er is indeed smart." Mr. Cai stroked his beard and laughed: "But it's not easy for orphans and widows. Anyway, it's not a big deal. If you can help, just help. If you ask them to go to Zhou Huyuan, just say it's the master's order."
"Master!" Li Min pouted with a look of reluctance: "You helped me with this matter today, and other relatives in my family know about it. I don't know how many people will come to my door in the future. I can't help but be annoyed to death, no."
"That's it for now. If you don't want to come forward, just ask your maid to take them to Zhou Guard."
Mr. Cai made the final decision, stretched out his hand to hold Li Min's shoulders and pulled her into his arms. Li Min threw his shoulders away a little angrily, but in the end he did not move away, and finally sat in Mr. Cai's arms reluctantly.
"Don't be angry. Next time, I will go to Fucheng and bring you some good things."
"That's pretty much it."
Li Min, who was hugged and comforted by Master Cai, bowed his head behind Master Cai's back, with a look of pride on his face.
…
…
Afternoon.
"Mrs. Lin, I have something to do over there, so I can't come here in person. Regarding the young man's martial arts training, I specifically asked me to take him to Zhou Huyuan."
The maid Xiaocui came, because the backyard of Cai Mansion was specially used for nursing homes and male servants to live, so Liu was not suitable to go.
"Sorry for the trouble, Miss Cui'er, Yan'er, you can go ahead."
Mrs. Liu handed Lin Yan a money bag: "When you see Zhou Huyuan, you must understand the etiquette."
